**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/145_R3.8__audit-event-encryption.md`
(seq 8 of 11, Round 3, manifest row 145). **Requirement ids:**
`BL-45`, `DF-S1.15-3`; `R-2.8.6`; ADR-0345 (revisit trigger (a) —
fired-answered), ADR-0359 (reserved `aead`/`rand` scope consumed);
ADR-0361 (new — the construction). **Base:**
`svitali/harnessharness-r3.7` — the stacked R3.7 tip (operator merges;
mergePolicy: OPERATOR). **Layer:** fixture-verified — real `ring`
AEAD exercised at test time over fixture keys; never live-attested,

## What

Discharges **BL-45**: per-event blob encryption at rest in
`hh-ledger`'s content-addressed blob pool — the last open DF-S1.15-3
cell — plus the non-custody R-2.8.6 audit-emission legs re-homed from
BL-21. Consumes ADR-0359's reserved `ring::aead`/`ring::rand` scope
exactly as written — **zero new `Cargo.toml` lines, no sibling dep
ADR**.

**1. The seam lives in `hh-ledger`, custody never does** (ADR-0361).
New `hh-ledger/src/cipher.rs`: the `BlobCipher` trait
(`algorithm`/`key_id`/`seal(address, plaintext)`/`open(address,
frame)`) and the `HHBE` v1 frame codec (`"HHBE" ‖ ver:u8 ‖
{alg, key_id, nonce} ‖ ciphertext‖tag`; header bytes are the AEAD
AAD). `Store::set_blob_cipher` installs it — mirrors
`set_audit_key_resolver`; no key bytes enter ledger state.

**2. Plaintext-addressed, ciphertext-resident.** `put_blob` computes
the content address over *plaintext* (I-A8 preserved — references,
dedup, and tombstones stay honest), seals, and writes the frame
atomically; existing-blob idempotence kept. `get_blob` detects
`HHBE`: malformed frame → `BlobCorrupt`; every open failure —
no cipher installed, foreign `key_id`, wrong key, AEAD tag mismatch —
answers `Missing{reason: key_unavailable}` (a well-formed frame that
cannot be opened is a custody absence, never a `Tampered` claim —
ADR-0068 R3); decrypted bytes are re-digested against the requested
address. A refusing seal is `CipherFault`, never a silent plaintext
write; once a cipher is installed there is no plaintext fallback.
HHZ1 retention compression skips sealed frames.

**3. The one production impl lives in `hh-secrets`** (CC1).
`RingBlobCipher`: `ring::aead::AES_256_GCM` over per-blob derived keys
(`hmac_sha256(master, "hh-ledger/blob/v1" ␟ address)`) + fresh 96-bit
`SystemRandom` nonces, header bound as AAD. The frame `key_id` is a
custody coordinate — key material is caller-held, never durable.

**4. The non-custody R-2.8.6 emission legs land on real call paths.**
Durable `RunManifest.blob_encryption{alg, key_id}` (coordinates only,
validated; spawned children inherit it via `hh-subagent`);
`BlobStatus::Sealed{key_id}` residency readable without custody;
`audit_view`'s `encryption` member (`enforced`/`unenforced`/
`undeclared`/`n/a`) + `completeness.encryption_ok` headline veto —
sealed-but-undeclared and unsealed-under-declaration veto honestly,
never a fabricated coverage claim (CC3). `hh-results`
(`verify_citation`, leaderboard `evidence_missing`) and
`hh-ledger::replay` treat `Sealed` as resolvable-present.

**5. Build memory.** DF-S1.15-3 `DONE` (dated — the row's last cell,
the row closes); BL-45 `closed`; `R-2.8.6` + `ADR-0345` re-homed to
BL-30 — custody-riding legs stay open on DF-S2.5-1/BL-30 +
DF-S1.15-1/BL-05, recorded not implemented; ADR-0345 carries the
dated fired-answered note for trigger (a); `R-2.8.6` stays `PARTIAL`
in the coverage matrix (honest — custody legs remain); ADR-0361 →
BL-42; `docs/adr/README.md` regenerated; AGENTS/Cargo.toml scope
comments updated.

## Note for the operator — host environment during this run

The `syspolicyd` first-exec pathology noted at R3.7 persists —
each freshly-linked test binary pays a launch stall, so the
workspace suite runs slow (the runs are green, not wedged). The
`HH_HELPER_SPAWN_DEADLINE_MS`/`HH_HELPER_CONNECT_DEADLINE_MS`
overrides cover the removability gate on the loaded host; defaults
stay the contract's 10 s/5 s (CI unaffected).
